articles.title: Automatic Transmission – a data-privacy study of connected vehicles
articles.summary: Research aims to investigate how connected vehicles and their companion mobile apps share personal consumer data with manufacturers and third parties, and to determine the manufacturer's response to these findings. The study examines two vantage points in the connected vehicle ecosystem: the vehicles themselves and the mobile apps provided by manufacturers. The researchers collected data on Wi-Fi traffic from 21 vehicles and 30 companion mobile apps, and found that both vehicles and apps share personal consumer data with third parties. The study's findings suggest that manufacturers may not be transparent about how they handle consumer data, and that consumers have limited control over their data once it has been shared.
